newsitem.title: USA: Gateway to acquire Advanced Logic.
newsitem.headline: Gateway to acquire Advanced Logic.

text.p: Gateway 2000 Inc. said Thursday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Irvine, Calif.-based computer server systems maker Advanced Logic Research Inc. for $15.50 per share in cash, or about $194 million.

Gateway said it expects the acquisition to add to its earnings immediately and anticipates incurring a one-time, non-cash charge for the write-off of research and development in process for Advanced Logic products.
